description: CES state-by-supersector payroll employment (BLS State Area Employment, FRED SMS ids) with every ALFRED vintage on every observation: 51 state-equivalents x total nonfarm, total private and the eleven supersectors. Gives the regional shift-share model a point-in-time employment panel, which no other employment source in this catalog has.

source.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED/ALFRED), from BLS State Area Employment (SAE/CES)
source.license_notes: FRED API Terms of Use (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html). The underlying series are U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data. Any series whose FRED notes name a third-party copyright holder is flagged in config.json series[*].third_party_copyright and on each observation; none are expected in this set.

acquisition.description: One FRED API observations request per (series, real-time window, offset slice) listed in config.json; every series requests every ALFRED vintage (realtime_start 1776-07-04 .. 9999-12-31, split into windows of <=1900 vintage dates and offset slices of 100,000 observations). Combinations are generated by build_config.py, which also measures the row count of every window.

sampling.reason: Full acquisition only (FRED API key required); the fred_* anchor datasets hold the schema-exploration samples
